title: Commercial Credit Account Late Payment Finance Charge
content:
A late payment finance charge on a Commercial Credit Account is assessed once per billing month, dated the last calendar day of the month, on the eligible past-due balance.

### Clauses

1. An invoice balance becomes eligible once it is more than the tier's grace days past its due date; finance charges themselves never accrue further finance charges (compounding is off for every tier), and on a tier that excludes disputed amounts, amounts under an open dispute are excluded.
2. No finance charge is assessed when the eligible balance is below the tier's waiver balance.
3. The charge is the eligible balance times the tier's monthly finance charge percent, rounded to the cent, raised to the tier's minimum charge when lower.
4. Each account receives at most one finance charge for a billing month.
5. Accounts in collections status continue to accrue the charge; closed and declined accounts do not.

### The eligible past-due balance

Measured on the last calendar day of the billing month being charged: the total of the open balances of posted invoices whose due date, moved later by the tier's grace days, is before that day — excluding finance charges themselves and, on a tier that excludes disputed amounts, amounts under an open dispute.

### Once-a-month check

The account's charge history decides: where a finance charge for that billing month already stands on the account, no second one is assessed for the same month.

### Worked charges (hypothetical tier: 1.5 percent monthly, waiver balance 50.00, minimum 5.00)

| Eligible balance | Computed | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 49.99 | — | none (below the waiver balance) |
| 50.00 | 0.75 | 5.00 (raised to the minimum) |
| 1000.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 |
| 1234.57 | 18.52 (18.51855 rounded) | 18.52 |
